anchor: v1::Theo Lindqvist here. The trail running shoes from order ORD-20457 don't suit me. They're unworn and still in the box. Can I send them back?

result.text: Yes, Theo, you can send them back. I've started return RMA-20457 for order ORD-20457, and there's no restocking fee. Your full refund of $129 will go out 5–7 business days after the warehouse receives the shoes, so please keep them in the box and ship them back with the return label.

output.refundTiming: 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
